recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed unless the work group later revisits the broader semantics of ImplementationGuide.global or default profiles.
issue_request: FHIR-13486 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for STU3 asking that ImplementationGuide section 5.8.3.2 mention .global so readers can discover that default profiles are represented by ImplementationGuide.global.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 12801. In the git mirror, commit 4d76fab9ca0cc616215fc2e79f6edbf4b8eb1cff (#13486 - IG clarification) is that revision and changed source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml to say that an implementation guide can define default profiles using ImplementationGuide.global. Current blame still attributes the surviving line to that commit.
additional_context: ImplementationGuide is active in source/fhir.ini, so the inspected source feeds the current build. The current StructureDefinition still defines ImplementationGuide.global and links its comment to the Default Profiles section. A contemporaneous Zulip discussion supports the same default-profile behavior, and searches found no direct Confluence reference or conflicting later FHIR-core Jira decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current Default Profiles narrative already names ImplementationGuide.global and the element definition remains consistent. No source edit was needed.
